sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOBBIES_2_089' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the aggregated sales (y) for the specified item_id (HOBBIES_2_089) grouped by quarter (quarter granularity) using the m5_calendar table for the time index (ds).
